Common questions

Can drapery go with shades I already have?

Usually, yes. Layering drapery over shades is common. We'll check that the hardware has room to clear your existing shades.

Sheers or lined panels?

Sheers soften light and keep some daytime view but give little privacy at night. Lined panels give privacy and more light control. Many rooms use both.

Can drapery be motorized?

Motorized tracks are available for large spans and hard-to-reach windows. We'll confirm options for your opening at the consultation.
